commands.title: List features
commands.description: List features: each feature's id, title, status, priority, problem and tags, filtered (every filter set must match), sorted (by id unless --sort-by says otherwise) and paged, with the total before paging.

args.name: status
args.description: Only features with this status: proposed (also a feature without one), accepted, in_progress, done, deferred or deprecated

args.name: priority
args.description: Only features with this priority: critical, high, medium, low

args.name: tags
args.description: Only features with at least one of these tags (comma-separated)

args.name: sort_by
args.description: The field to sort by (default id): id, title or a field a feature declares; ties by id

args.name: sort_order
args.description: asc (the default) or desc

args.name: limit
args.description: Return at most this many (default 100, clamped to 1-1000)

args.name: offset
args.description: Skip this many first (default 0)

commands.title: Show milestone completion progress
commands.description: How many of a milestone's features are done: the count, the ratio in [0, 1] and their ids.

args.name: milestone
args.description: The milestone id

commands.title: Show journey feature-module coverage
commands.description: How many of a journey's features are done, and the ones that are not.

args.name: journey
args.description: The journey id

commands.title: Show feature impact analysis
commands.description: What deferring or removing a feature touches: the journeys, milestones and modules that list it, the deliverables holding those journeys or modules, the features depending on it (transitively), and their total.

args.name: feature
args.description: The feature id

commands.title: Show features that depend on a given feature
commands.description: The features that declare depends_on the feature, sorted by id.

args.name: feature
args.description: The feature id

commands.title: Show features reachable from a persona (via journeys)
commands.description: The features of every journey the persona undertakes, and those journeys, sorted.

args.name: persona
args.description: The persona id

commands.title: Show features reachable from a channel (via journeys)
commands.description: The features of every journey that uses the channel, and those journeys, sorted.

args.name: channel
args.description: The channel id

commands.title: Show the features a deliverable reaches
commands.description: Every feature a deliverable reaches through its journeys or its modules, once each, and how many each path reaches.

args.name: deliverable
args.description: The deliverable id

commands.title: Show the deliverables holding a feature
commands.description: Every deliverable that holds a feature through one of its journeys or modules, once each, and how many each path reaches.

args.name: feature
args.description: The feature id

commands.title: Show the channels a persona uses (via journeys)
commands.description: The channels of every journey the persona undertakes, once each, sorted.

args.name: persona
args.description: The persona id

commands.title: Show the personas a deliverable serves (via journeys)
commands.description: The personas the deliverable's journeys target, once each, sorted, and the journeys that connect them.

args.name: deliverable
args.description: The deliverable id

commands.title: Show deliverable completion
commands.description: How many of the milestones a deliverable is tracked by are completed, as a count and a ratio in [0, 1]; --details adds each milestone's feature completion.

args.name: deliverable
args.description: The deliverable id

args.name: details
args.description: Include each milestone's feature completion

commands.title: Show release completion
commands.description: How many of a release's deliverables are shipped, as a count and a ratio in [0, 1] (null without deliverables).

args.name: release
args.description: The release id

commands.title: Show a deliverable's derived priority
commands.description: The highest priority among the milestones and journeys a deliverable references that declare one (null when none does), and how many declare one.

args.name: deliverable
args.description: The deliverable id

commands.title: Show features no milestone schedules
commands.description: The features no milestone lists, sorted by id, with how many features there are and how many are scheduled.

commands.title: Show ownership by owner
commands.description: Per owner, the features, milestones, deliverables and releases it owns (most first, ties by owner), paged, and how many of those entities have no owner.

args.name: limit
args.description: Return at most this many (default 100, clamped to 1-1000)

args.name: offset
args.description: Skip this many first (default 0)

commands.title: Show features in dependency order
commands.description: Every feature, dependencies before dependents, by priority within a level (none counts as medium), then by id; features on or behind a depends_on cycle come last, and the cycle's members are reported.

commands.title: Show the critical path through milestones
commands.description: The longest depends_on chain of milestones not yet completed, earliest first, with target dates, zero slack and the blocked or in-progress bottlenecks; empty, with a message, when milestones depend on each other in a cycle.

commands.title: Show a module's dependency depth
commands.description: The longest depends_on chain from a module, the module first, and its length in edges; -1 and the cycle's members when the module is on or behind a dependency cycle.

args.name: module
args.description: The module id

commands.title: Show module coupling
commands.description: Each module's fan-in, fan-out and their sum over depends_on, most coupled first, paged, with the averages and the most coupled module.

args.name: limit
args.description: Return at most this many (default 100, clamped to 1-1000)

args.name: offset
args.description: Skip this many first (default 0)

commands.title: Show deliverables that depend on a given deliverable
commands.description: The deliverables that declare depends_on the deliverable, sorted by id.

args.name: deliverable
args.description: The deliverable id

commands.title: Show the persona coverage matrix
commands.description: Per persona, by id, the features its journeys reach and the ones they do not, with the coverage ratio and journey count, paged; the feature total and the mean coverage over every persona.

args.name: limit
args.description: Return at most this many (default 100, clamped to 1-1000)

args.name: offset
args.description: Skip this many first (default 0)

commands.title: Show the channel coverage matrix
commands.description: Per channel, by id, the features the journeys using it reach and the ones they do not, with the coverage ratio and journey count, paged; the feature total and the mean coverage over every channel.

args.name: limit
args.description: Return at most this many (default 100, clamped to 1-1000)

args.name: offset
args.description: Skip this many first (default 0)

commands.title: Show features shared across deliverables
commands.description: The features two or more deliverables reach through a journey or a module, with those deliverables, most shared first, paged.

args.name: limit
args.description: Return at most this many (default 100, clamped to 1-1000)

args.name: offset
args.description: Skip this many first (default 0)

commands.title: Show the terms related to a term
commands.description: The terms reachable from a term over see_also within --max-hops (default 1, at most 5), sorted by id, the term itself left out.

args.name: term
args.description: The term id

args.name: max_hops
args.description: How many see_also hops to follow (default 1; above 5 counts as 5)

commands.title: Show clusters of related terms
commands.description: The connected components of the see_also graph between terms (undirected), largest first, ties by first term id; terms with no see_also link are counted as isolated.

commands.title: Show how connected the glossary is
commands.description: Terms, see_also references between them, average and maximum connections, hub terms (more than twice the average and at least 3) and isolated terms.

commands.title: Show status breakdown across all entity kinds
commands.description: For each product kind with a lifecycle, how many entities have each status.

commands.title: Show project health score
commands.description: A 0-100 score averaging coverage, connectivity and completeness of the product graph, with entity and orphan counts.
